# Shimada Enriques configuration data

[Official computational-data page](https://www.math.sci.hiroshima-u.ac.jp/~shimada/K3andEnriques.html).
The historical transfer uses these pinned inputs:

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `L10L26Note.pdf` | `b88acf9d1f4602724117e1270431a3cf0afe31e4214ab820ad2796125be2fc3e` |
| `L10L26NoteCompData.pdf` | `a2744b6f5826ee23e8170aa7b90beea9fb836e46078a465ccee0ba2349840361` |
| `L10L26compdata2.txt` | `218c8188e467bde29369cdeda3771d767c3f70105d8fb56def8d698b90e75a6c` |

The dictionary is `I=12A, II=12B, III=20B, IV=20F, V=20A, VI=20E,
VII=20C=20D`. The raw `GramL10`, ten-coordinate `walls` and complete
`configuration` matrix are parsed as balanced integer arrays and quoted
names; the project parser does not execute GAP source.

[Detailed source scope](https://sashakolpakov.github.io/CoxeterPolytopes/sources.html#shimada-configurations)
